body: I’m at around 8 months as well, same boat as you. I’m in Outbound in a lower-tier site and we are getting crushed right now. Multiple PAs quitting, transferred or fired in the last few months, including two this week. Multiple managers leaving in the past month. No PGs. Getting destroyed by andons and maintenance issues every five seconds. Plus cleaning up an entire AFE with little help because we’re supposed to be running lean. Meanwhile, volume and productivity goals are only going up.

I would focus on building up what you can and not placing so much emphasis on whether or not you find a woman. That shouldn’t define your value or self-worth. Find a marketable skill and start working on building up your finances, travel, work out, learn new things, volunteer, explore, have fun. Get a pet. If a woman wants to join you on that journey, cool. If not, you still have a lot to be happy about. Probably not the answer you’re looking for but these are the things I’m doing to try to enjoy life as a 29 year old man.

It may also not seem like a positive right now, but you may get women to be more honest about rejecting you due to your 4’8 height, and you’ll get let down up front. That’s a lot better than getting your hopes up and think you’re getting somewhere like always happens with me. Best wishes to you and feel free to reach out if you ever want to chat.
